name: Divider
description: A separator between content, as a single or double line, a dashed line or a filled band, with an optional label.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the line. A vertical divider stretches to the height of its flex row, or takes a height from className.

props.name: variant
props.description: A hairline, two hairlines 3 pixels apart, a dashed hairline, or a 6 pixel band of muted colour.

props.name: label
props.description: Text set into the line. The line breaks around it with a 12 pixel gap on each side.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Where the label sits along the line.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts the other props of the react-aria-components Separator.
